issues.description: Class Farm: the problem statement and template usage expect a public no-argument constructor Farm() that initializes the internal ArrayList of animals. The solution implementation only provides a constructor with an int parameter (public Farm(int initialCapacity)) and does not provide a no-arg Farm() constructor. This mismatch will cause code or tests that call new Farm() (as shown in the template Main and required by the exercise text) to fail to compile or force students to add a constructor not shown in the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a public no-argument constructor to Farm that initializes the animals list, for example: public Farm() { this.animals = new ArrayList<>(); } Optionally keep the existing Farm(int initialCapacity) overload, but ensure Farm() exists so code and tests that call new Farm() compile and behave as described in the problem statement.
